title: Canonical finite-coefficient absolute-Frobenius pullback trivialization
statement: Let $p$ be prime, let $X$ be a scheme of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-scheme-characteristic-p], let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $b\in\mathbf N$. Write $H=F_X^b$ for the iterate of absolute Frobenius [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme]. On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use the ordinary unbounded constant-coefficient derived category and identified-coefficient pullback $LH_A^*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define $\tau_{X,A}^{(b)}:LH_A^*\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{id}$ to be the exact termwise derived descent, with the canonical derived identity comparison, of the normalized module-pullback trivialization supplied by [lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback]. This is the trivialization of [lem-trf-absolute-frobenius-site]: for a weakly etale object $v:V\to X$, the site isomorphism is the relative Frobenius $r_V^{(b)}=(F_V^b,v):V\xrightarrow{\sim}V\times_{X,H}X$; the module trivialization is fixed by requiring that the pullback-adjunction unit followed by direct image of its forward map acts on sections by restriction along $(r_V^{(b)})^{-1}$. The coefficient identification is the canonical constant-section identification in the specified module pullback. Exponent zero is included with its canonical identity-pullback unitor. No coefficient flatness, prime-to-$p$ annihilator, boundedness or constructibility is assumed.

def coefficientFrobeniusTrivialization (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (hX : X.IsCharacteristic p)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (b : ℕ) :
    proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A (X.iterateFrobenius hp (hX.2 ⊤) b) ≅
      𝟭 (proEtaleDerivedCategory X A)
